title: Marrow inside bone is where new blood cells are made
summary: NIAMS says some bone holds a jelly-like marrow, and new blood cells are made inside that marrow.
body: NIAMS says some types of bone hold a jelly-like material called marrow. New blood cells are made inside that marrow. The lesson lists the job apart from holding the body up. This card is only that blood-cell workshop. It does not describe a transplant, a lab test, or a disease.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Bones
sources.author: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
sources.note: US government page, public domain. Last Updated June 2025. Supports bone marrow as jelly-like material inside some bones where new blood cells are made.
